article.title: Colombia’s new president Abelardo de la Espriella announces immigration crackdown
article.summary: Far-right leader echoes ally Donald Trump and says operations to ‘track down illegal immigrants’ should begin this week, amid earthquake aftermathColombia’s far-right president, Abelardo de la Espriella, has announced a crackdown on immigrants, ordering authorities to detain and deport people who are in the country irregularly or have committed crimes.In office for just over two weeks, the millionaire former lawyer made the announcement on Sunday as the country continued to grapple with theaftermath of a 7.4-magnitude earthquakeon 10 August that killed more than 300 people and destroyed more than 30,000 homes.Continue reading...

article.title: Abelardo de la Espriella orders immediate deportation of irregular immigrants from Colombia: ‘It’s a political decision’
article.summary: The far-right president announces coordinated operations between the police and immigration agency to expel foreigners who ‘are committing crimes’ or ‘who have not regularized their status’
